subject: Allow running single integration test (#303)
reason: The change modifies only developer tooling: build.sh gains a --run-integration-tests=pattern option to filter which integration tests run, scripts/common.rc fixes a shell test for an unset SAN_BUILD variable and a log message typo. No source file of the valkey-search module is touched, so the built module artifact and its runtime behaviour (commands, replies, indexing, replication, persistence) are identical on both sides. This is a build/CI-script change with no behaviour to test against a running server.
